name: @types/noita-ts
description: Global ambient typings for Noita TypeScript mods (Noita API, Lua stdlib, TSTL language extensions).

scripts.typegen: npm run typegen:api && npm run typegen:components
scripts.typegen:api: tsx bin/main.ts lua bin/lua_api_documentation.txt -f fixups.d.ts -o generated/lua_api.d.ts
